quest.title: Three Flames Light the Way
quest.description: The torch atop the Guili Plains watchtower acts as a guide for travelers. Help Xinghuo light three torches.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: How have the torches gone out again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with the torches?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Ah, traveler. Look ahead, can you see three watchtowers? The torches on them should all be lit...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: The roads along Guili Plains can be difficult to traverse at the best of times, worse still when there are monsters out there in hiding. The torches aren't just to light the way for travelers, they also indicate that there is no threat from monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: But... I was so busy clearing out monsters in the area that I completely forgot to stoke the fires. By the time I realized it was too late, and they'd all gone out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll light them for you.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: That would be great. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Along this road there are three watchtowers, each with their own torch. After you've lit them all, make sure to come back and see me again, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: At the end of the road, there is a Statue of The Seven. Perhaps while you are down that way you can visit it, perhaps receive the blessings of the Geo Lord.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: It may be easy but it still needs doing — so thank you, and please don't forget.

talks.objective: Light the watchtower torch on the plains

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Please traveler, get the fires lit soon. The inspector could be here at any moment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the road.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Guili Plains sits atop a range of rock formations, so some areas are a bit more rugged, like the slope heading towards the watchtower west of here.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: To the east, towards the sea is quite flat, however. If you have the time you should head that way and check out Yaoguang Shoal.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about your colleagues?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: So they look after fueling the fires, while it's my responsibility to get them lit.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Sure it sounds trivial, but it's important that we each perform our role.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Phew... Alright, we should be all good now! Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: This is for you, to say thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why can't you do it?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Ah, it's 'cause they come to check the fires. If it's me here, I can buy a bit more time.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: It's no good if you stand here or if there's no-one here at all.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: So please, traveler, go and light the torches for me!

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Wait! Could you help me? Could you go and light the torches in my place?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Wait! Could you help me? Could you go and light the torches in my place?
